prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, grab it and check its properties. If not visible, approach it, otherwise move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
